method: CPU only; exact current V5World gate prefix and viewWeight executed for every frame, actual current V5CameraPath, real atlas organ centers and reconstructed current procedural anchors. Actual garment geometry sampled at affected-range edges/midpoints; measurement deformation is not simulated here.

conservativeBBox.purpose: Generous union of standing and seated body-attached shorts; includes non-visible space.

tightStandingBBox.purpose: Secondary diagnostic only; measurement pose not guaranteed, not valid as sole render guard.

limitations: Camera-frustum rejection does not rule out cast-shadow changes. Garment meshes have castShadow=true and current Three.js shadow behavior must be assessed before excluding offscreen geometry.
Use full visible-alpha support plus h005 camera support for conservative patch planning; do not silently omit frustum-excluded ranges.
These results do not certify frame aesthetics, transparency ordering, labels, or compositing seams.
